about: The pinned inputs of liveMd2Tex's own TeX engine (docs/DEVELOPING.md, "The TeX engine: our own build"). engine/build/build.sh --fetch downloads each archive by its address into <root>/downloads, and every run checks each archive's size and SHA-256 against this file before it is used. The SHA-256 values were recorded at the first download (2026-10-31, anonymous). Never commit the archives themselves.

texLive.note: The head of the branch refs/heads/tags/texlive-2026.1 ('texlive-2026.1 tag based on r78399, with dvipdfmx psfile quoting fix'). There is no git tag of that name, so the commit is pinned, never the branch.

emscripten.note: releasesBuild is the emscripten-releases build that emsdk's emscripten-releases-tags.json (at the emsdk commit below) names for 6.0.13; wasm-binaries.tar.xz is that build. The source archive is not used by the build: it is the corresponding source of the runtime and system libraries compiled into the engine, attached to the engine release.

emsdk.note: build.sh unpacks this archive, puts the two hash-checked archives below into emsdk/downloads under the names emsdk expects, and runs 'emsdk install 6.0.13' with EMSDK_KEEP_DOWNLOADS=1, so emsdk reuses them and downloads nothing (emsdk.py download_file; the SDK's Linux dependencies are node-24.19.0-64bit and releases-<releasesBuild>-64bit, emsdk_manifest.json).

hostTools.about: What build.sh needs on the build machine (Ubuntu package names); engine.yml installs this list. build.sh passes gawk as AWK to both configure runs (Ubuntu's default awk is mawk). The fontCheck packages are for the font check only (engine/build/tools/font-check.mjs, with a native fc-scan of fontconfig 2.13.96 as the reference); nothing built from them ships.
